name: T4-Z4N
description: T4-Z4N was an astromech droid who served the Resistance on the planet Ajan Kloss during the First Order-Resistance War. The droid was one of five astromechs who worked under R5-2JE and who were all absent from their jobs at the landing pad one day. T4-Z4N was busy swinging through the trees instead of doing R5-2JE's work.
